parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- `zh`: Chinese

- `en`: English

parameters.name: FcAlias
parameters.description: The alias of the Function Compute (FC) service. This parameter is applicable only when `SourceType` is set to `FC`.

parameters.name: FcServiceName
parameters.description: The name of the Function Compute (FC) service. This parameter is applicable only when `SourceType` is set to `FC`.

parameters.name: FcVersion
parameters.description: The version of the FC service. This parameter is applicable only when `SourceType` is set to `FC`.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

sub_parameters.name: DnsServerList
sub_parameters.description: The list of DNS servers. This parameter is applicable only when `SourceType` is set to `DNS`.

parameters.name: SourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service source from which services are imported.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The service source. Valid values: `MSE` (an MSE Nacos instance), `K8s` (an ACK container service), `VIP` (a fixed address), `DNS` (a DNS domain name), `EDAS` (an EDAS application), `SAE` (an SAE application), `FC` (a Function Compute service), and `MSE_ZK` (an MSE ZooKeeper instance).

parameters.name: TlsSetting
parameters.description:
The TLS settings, specified as a JSON string. The following fields are supported:

- `mode`: The TLS mode.

- `certId`: The certificate ID.

- `caCertId`: The CA certificate ID.

- `caCertContent`: The public key of the CA certificate.

- `sni`: The Server Name Indication (SNI).
